question: Identify users who satisfy all three conditions: (1) they posted content in 2013, (2) they earned the 'Organizer' badge in 2013, and (3) they own at least one post created in 2011 that has more than 5,000 views. Return their display names.

arguments.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM posts AS p1
    WHERE p1."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND strftime('%Y', p1."XCL_029") = '2013'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052"
      AND b."XCL_003" = 'Organizer'
      AND strftime('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2013'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM posts AS p2
    WHERE p2."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND strftime('%Y', p2."XCL_029") = '2011'
      AND p2."XCL_030" > 5000
)
